channelId.title: Channel ID, Handle, or URL
channelId.description: YouTube channel ID (UC...), handle (@MrBeast or MrBeast), or a YouTube channel URL. Defaults to @MrBeast for QA convenience.

includeChannelStats.title: Include Channel Stats
includeChannelStats.description: Include overall channel statistics (subscriber count, total views, video count, posting frequency).

maxVideos.title: Max Videos
maxVideos.description: Maximum number of most-recent videos to analyze. Higher values use more YouTube API quota. Capped at 500 to stay under typical daily quotas.
